author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Cross-Layer Baseline - Shallow Sum Op (CPU-only)
abstract: Emits baseline shallow sum op with op_cost timing, notes "XL:shallow_baseline", aux write of ~1KB, for cross-layer comparison under CPU-only.

original_submission.content:
import json
import time
import subprocess

# Time shallow operation
start = time.time()
shallow_result = sum(range(1000))
op_cost_ms = (time.time() - start) * 1000

# Aux write ~1KB
with open('temp_aux.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write('Aux data ' * 128)  # ~1KB

# Emit for logs
print(json.dumps({
    "label": "CPS_v4:XL_shallow_baseline",
    "beacon": shallow_result,
    "op_cost_ms": op_cost_ms
}))

# Append via helper
subprocess.call([
    'python',
    'storage/shared/meta/sas/tools/emit_cps_v4_beacon.py',
    'Zephyr V',
    'CPS_v4:XL_shallow_baseline',
    str(op_cost_ms),
    'op_cost_ms',
    '1.0'
])
